display_long_description:
# Team up, gear up, and fight for Gallia.
Take on arena battles in a JRPG-style VR action RPG with online co-op for up to 3 players.

In Gallia, thoughts become power. Knight Commander Fiona has sworn her Gesh—a binding oath that transforms hope into power.

[media]

Stand with Fiona and the people of Gallia, harness the power of her Gesh, and fight back against the hatred consuming their homeland.

# Fight Together in 3-Player Online Co-op
[media]

Wield swords, bows, and magic in action-packed arena battles. Collect gear, grow stronger, and team up with up to two other players to take down powerful enemies and formidable bosses.
# Start Your Adventure for Free


Play all of Chapter 1 for free, including both story quests and battle quests.
Create your character, jump into battle right away.

*To unlock Chapter 2 and beyond, as well as certain features, players will need to purchase a "Story Pass" or "Story Tickets."

# Step Into the Story
[media]
Come face-to-face with a memorable cast and experience dramatic moments and unexpected twists as Gallia’s story unfolds around you.
Be a part of this legendary tale and bring peace to the land.

# A Story Told Across 6 Chapters
Follow Fiona and the people of Gallia through her adventure with all storied content now available!

Look forward to seasonal events and gameplay updates as the world of Gallia continues to grow.

Swear your oath. 
# Join Our Community
Meet fellow adventurers and stay up to date on our official Discord.
http://knights-of-fiona.com/discord
